name: arquitetura-llm
description: Ambiente de desenvolvimento do Orca e Paperclip para arquitetura--LLM

scripts.setup: npm run catalog:setup && npm run orca:setup && npm run paperclip:setup
scripts.catalog:setup: git submodule update --init --depth 1 -- awesome-linux-dev claude-melhores-skills awesome-claude-code-mods
scripts.orca:setup: git submodule update --init --depth 1 -- orca && npm run orca:install
scripts.orca:install: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.14.0 -- pnpm --dir orca install --frozen-lockfile && npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.14.0 -- pnpm --dir orca/mobile install --frozen-lockfile && npm run orca:runtime
scripts.orca:runtime: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.14.0 -- pnpm --dir orca run ensure:electron-runtime
scripts.orca:dev: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.14.0 -- pnpm --dir orca run dev
scripts.orca:dev:container: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.14.0 -- pnpm --dir orca run dev --noSandbox
